name: lago-qbo-sync
description: Scheduled pull sync of Lago billing documents into QuickBooks Online

scripts.sync: npm run build --silent && node --env-file=.env dist/src/cli/index.js sync
scripts.dry-run: npm run build --silent && node --env-file=.env dist/src/cli/index.js dry-run
scripts.check-config: npm run build --silent && node --env-file=.env dist/src/cli/index.js check-config
scripts.auth: npm run build --silent && node --env-file=.env dist/src/cli/index.js auth
